nl: Add the option `maxsize 100M` as the last option of etc/logrotate.d/orders, before the closing brace, indented by four spaces.
reference_bash:
python3 - <<'EOF'
import pathlib
p = pathlib.Path('etc/logrotate.d/orders'); t = p.read_text()
assert t.count('    missingok\n}') == 1
p.write_text(t.replace('    missingok\n}', '    missingok\n    maxsize 100M\n}'))
EOF
